verdict.rationale: Gazebo Sim documents a dedicated server-only headless mode (-s flag) and even a lightweight server-only package with no GUI/Qt deps, plus extensive CLI tools for scripted control and TCP/IP transport for remote/automated interfacing — all consistent with running in CI/automation pipelines. Missing for 10: no explicit CI pipeline example/Dockerfile or documented exit-code/scripting pattern for automated test runs, and no independent third-party corroboration of CI usage.
